steps.text: Cut or tear-Cut or tear 1 slices of bread into bite-size pieces
visible_evidence: hands tearing or cutting a slice of bread
bite-size bread pieces on a work surface

checks.text: The bread is divided into bite-size pieces

steps.text: melt-In a large mug, melt 1 tablespoon of softened butter in the microwave for about 30 seconds
visible_evidence: butter placed inside a large mug
mug placed in the microwave
liquid melted butter at the bottom of the mug

checks.text: The butter is placed in a large mug
The mug is microwaved for about 30 seconds
The butter is melted into a liquid

steps.text: Roll-Roll the butter around in the mug to coat it
visible_evidence: hands tilting and rotating the mug
melted butter coating the inner sides of the mug

checks.text: The mug is rotated so the melted butter coats the inner walls

steps.text: whisk-In the mug, whisk one egg with a fork until well blended
visible_evidence: egg cracked into the mug
fork whisking the egg inside the mug
uniformly blended yellow egg liquid in the mug

checks.text: A fork is used to whisk the egg inside the mug
The egg yolk and white are blended into a uniform liquid

steps.text: Sprinkle-Sprinkle 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon over the egg
visible_evidence: measuring spoon sprinkling cinnamon into the mug
cinnamon visible on top of the egg mixture

checks.text: Cinnamon is sprinkled over the egg in the mug

steps.text: Add-Add 1/4 teaspoon vanilla extract to the mug
visible_evidence: measuring spoon pouring dark liquid into the mug

checks.text: Vanilla extract is added to the mug

visible_evidence: utensil stirring the liquid inside the mug
cinnamon and vanilla mixed throughout the egg

checks.text: The contents of the mug are stirred together with a utensil

steps.text: add-add bread pieces to the egg mixture in the mug, pressing the bread down into the egg
visible_evidence: bread pieces dropped into the mug
hand or utensil pressing the bread down into the egg mixture

checks.text: The bread pieces are added to the egg mixture in the mug
The bread pieces are pressed down into the egg liquid

steps.text: Microwave-Microwave on high for 90 seconds until the egg is cooked through
visible_evidence: mug placed inside the microwave
cooked solid egg and bread mixture in the mug

checks.text: The mug is microwaved for 90 seconds
The egg mixture is solid and cooked through

steps.text: Put-Put the mug's contents on a plate

cooked mixture resting on a plate

checks.text: The cooked contents are transferred from the mug onto a plate

steps.text: cut-cut the contents on plate, and serve

cut portions arranged on the plate
